name: b1-pruefungstrainer
description: Open-source practice examinations for German B1 certificate exams — timed mock papers, generated listening audio, auto-grading, speaking recorder.
author: Dipraj Kadlag

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@b1/core && npm run build --workspace=@b1/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.content:all: npm run content:validate && npm run content:audio && npm run content:pdf && npm run content:export
